notes: Regression lens. Nothing this round broke a budget or a gate. Round-1 problems (structure light flood, black-hole scorch, ink blobs, silence dark ball, opaque sweep cones, single respawn column, summon ink stain, weak resist shred, item procs, monster death, wind-up readability) are all visibly addressed in the gameplay-camera sheets. Sensitivity: no faces or hoods involved.
